experiment: Does the BOINC-trained adapter still beat its base model after conversion to GGUF (the files that would be served)?
engine: llama.cpp llama-perplexity, CPU, base base-f16.gguf + f16 LoRA GGUF
label: independent chunks (selection chunks skipped)
held_out: 64 chunks x 128 tokens per domain from moe_work's never-trained eval rows; domains ['general', 'french', 'edu_web', 'news', 'biomed', 'math']

gate.rule: pooled mean NLL gain > 0, paired bootstrap 95% interval of the gain excludes 0, no domain worse than +1%

selection_independent: first 8 chunks of every held-out stream skipped (the chain chose its best round on them)
caveat: Language-model loss on text, not task accuracy. The adapter was trained on an NF4 base and is measured here on an f16 base. A base model has no chat tuning.
